overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating Multiple-Choice Question generation using both traditional metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, etc.) and novel knowledge-dependent metrics (KDA). The extraction was generally good but needed significant normalization of model names and consolidation of redundant entries. The paper uses PLMs as evaluators by having them solve MCQs, which qualifies as LLM-as-judge methodology.
